name: Szalatnak (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner with two horizontal bands of green and yellow at the bottom, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Szalatnak (a blue and green shield with a yellow tree and a cross, with a helm and green mantling) above a scroll inscribed SZALATNAK.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Szalatnak arms with helm, mantling and scroll
